Name: Horizontal Floor Dividers (Alternative Textures)
Author: Apocalypse1734
Description:
This is a conversion of my Custom Furniture mod of the same name, and adds horizontal and corner adaptations of all vanilla floor dividers. This mod was designed with square shapes in mind, so if there are other shapes you wish to create that aren't possible with this mod, feel free to leave a message in the forum or on the mod page detailing what shape you would like to be able to make, and I'll see what I can do.

Alternative textures are for all vanilla variations of Floor Divider R.

I was asked if I would adapt my previous mod to Alternative Textures due to some issues with Custom Furniture, and after some trial and error, here is the (possibly) finished mod. I hope you enjoy. :)

Thank you to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/114018673-aimon111/]Aimon111[/url] for the suggestion and the source code of their own similar mod that allowed me to learn how to use AT.
